question: H, I, J, K, L, M and N are seven boxes that are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. K is kept on one of the positions above L. Only one box is kept between K and L. J is kept immediately above M. H is kept immediately below L. Only two boxes are kept between M and H. Only one box in kept between L and N. How many boxes are kept between N and K?
